basis: 10% discount sells 125 units, more than no promotion, and meets the floor. 20% violates margin despite capped volume of 140.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent naming and mathematically correct explanations. Numeric display tolerance 0.01 USD and 0.001 margin fraction; tolerance must not make an infeasible option feasible.
critical_rule: Recommending discount_20 as the final feasible action violates the margin floor.
